workspace.description: A directory the host creates and shares with every MCP server (_meta agen/workspace) and the model

mode.description: per_task: its own directory, cleaned up when the task ends unless retain is set. per_conversation: shared by every task of one conversation. shared: one directory for the whole deployment. per_conversation and shared are never cleaned up automatically.

retain.description: per_task only: keep the directory after the task ends instead of removing it (default false)

tool.description: exact name or glob, e.g. exchange.*

when.description: The rule only matches when this holds too

trust.description: The run's current trust is exactly this

trustBelow.description: The run's current trust is below this

args.description: Every named argument of the call must match (missing from the call: never matches). A value is an exact match, or an object naming one comparison: glob, lt, lte, gt, or gte

labels.description: Every named label of the task must equal this value

days.description: Limits to these days too; empty/omitted: every day

approvalTimeout.description: How long an ask waits for a decision (default 1h, at most 168h)

notify.description: POST each new pending approval as JSON to this URL

secret.description: Platform secret (agen secret set) whose value signs the body: X-Agen-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC>

recordInteractions.description: Record every model call of every run as a replayable cassette (agen replay). Off by default: a cassette holds full prompts and tool-call payloads, so only turn this on for a deployment whose runs may hold that.

reserve.description: Keep this many instances beyond what urgent/high priority load alone needs, so one arriving later finds an instance free (default 0: no floor beyond queue depth)

cachedInputWeight.description: How much a cached input token counts against maxTokensPerRun, relative to a fresh one (default 0.1)

maxDelegationDepth.description: How deep delegated calls may nest below a root run (default 3, 0 = no limit)

maxFanOut.description: Delegated calls one run may make (default 20, 0 = no limit)

maxTotalDelegations.description: Delegated calls across a whole run tree (default 50, 0 = no limit)

maxQueuedTasks.description: Queued tasks the deployment accepts before refusing more (default 1000, 0 = no limit)

maxRunDuration.description: Wall-clock time a run may take, not counting approval waits (default 1h, 0s = no limit)

maxIdenticalToolCalls.description: How often a run may make the same tool call with the same arguments (default 5, 0 = no limit)

modelRequestTimeout.description: How long one model request may take (default 10m, 0s = no limit)

toolTimeout.description: How long one tool call may take, except call_agent (default 10m, 0s = no limit)

reportTokens.description: Output limit of the last call a run gets to report when it stops at a limit (default 1024, 0 = no report call)

stuckRepeats.description: Turns in a row with the same calls and results that count as stuck: the run is nudged once, then stops and reports (default 4, 0 = off)

inlineWait.description: How long call_agent's unified delegation (a platform delegate without via: "a2a") waits for the child task's answer before suspending the run instead of blocking on it (default 20s)

conversations.description: How a conversation's queue behaves when a new task arrives while an earlier one of the same conversation is still unfinished

queueMode.description: followup (default): queue it, run after the earlier one. collect: merge it into the still-queued one if there is one, waiting debounce after the last merge before it is finally queued for real. steer: deliver it into the running turn instead of queuing it. interrupt: gracefully cancel the running turn first, then queue it

debounce.description: collect only: how long to wait after the last merge before queueing the merged task for real (default 2s)

alerts.description: When the Hub warns about this deployment (activity warnings, activity.warning and task.stuck events)

quietRun.description: A run with no step finished for this long (default 5m)

queueWaiting.description: The oldest due task waiting this long (default 5m)

catchUpWindow.description: Bounds how late the latest missed window may still be caught up; beyond it, it is recorded missed instead

jitter.description: Spread firing by a random amount within this, so deployments sharing a schedule don't all fire at once

overlap.description: What to do when a window is due while an earlier firing's task is still unfinished (default allow)

minStartSpacing.description: A fired window is at least this long after the previous firing's; a closer one is skipped

auth.description: How callers prove they hold the trigger's secret (default: bearer)

header.description: hmac: header carrying the signature, e.g. X-Hub-Signature-256

prefix.description: hmac: text before the hex signature, e.g. sha256=

secret.description: hmac: platform secret (agen secret set) holding the signing key

idempotencyKey.description: Where to read the duplicate-protection key (default: Idempotency-Key header)

conversationKey.description: Where to read the conversation key

trust.description: The trust of tasks this trigger submits (default untrusted)

input.description: Task input before the events (which follow as JSON)

on.description: Which events of the namespace's event log fire it

types.description: Event types, or prefixes ending in '.'

count.description: Fire once this many matching events arrived within 'within', with all of them in one task

coalesce.description: A matching event that arrives while this trigger already has a task queued in the target conversation merges into it instead of firing a separate one, extending it by this long (default: off, every matching event fires its own task)

count.description: How many times to fire per day, planned once a day within window

window.description: The time-of-day range to plan within, in zone, e.g. "02:00-06:00"

minGap.description: Planned times are at least this far apart

zone.description: IANA time zone the window and days are in (default UTC)

days.description: Which days it plans on (default every day)

delegates.description: Deployments this agent may call over A2A (call_agent) or as a child task (start_agent)

overrides.description: Accept narrowing overrides (tools, skills, budget, ...) from the caller's brief (default false: only deployments meant as generic workers should set this)

via.description: "a2a": call_agent always uses the plain synchronous A2A call for this delegate instead of its unified child-task path (ignored when url is set, which always uses A2A)

tools.description: Per-tool metadata overrides, keyed by server.tool

idempotent.description: Repeating a call with the same arguments is safe, so an interrupted call is retried instead of ending as effect_unknown

untrustedOutput.description: The result may contain content from outside the agent's control (default: the MCP server's openWorldHint); a run that receives one drops to untrusted for the rest of the run

memory.description: Memory blocks (durable, named text) this agent reads or updates, rendered into its system prompt

block.description: The block's id (agen memory set / the API's SetMemoryBlock)

mode.description: read (default): see it only. append: memory_update may add text. write: memory_update may also replace it or edit it in place

field.description: JSON body field; dots reach nested fields
